question_text: The Indigenous People's Mandatory Representative (IPMR) of a municipality invokes the Indigenous Peoples Rights Act (IPRA) to stop a mining company from operating within an ancestral domain without the consent of the Indigenous Cultural Community (ICC). Which of the following best supports the IPMR's action?

options.text: The IPRA grants the ICC ownership of all mineral resources within their ancestral domain.
The IPRA requires free, prior, and informed consent (FPIC) from the ICC before any project within ancestral domains.
The IPRA gives the IPMR absolute veto power over any government project in the area.
The IPRA allows the ICC to unilaterally cancel any existing mining permits.
